product_metadata.title: OrganicTextiles Natural Latex Pillow with Organic Cotton Cover, King Size, Medium, GOTS Certified, Helps Relieve Pressure, Sleeping Support, Back and Side Sleepers
features: MATERIALS: We use 100% natural latex instead of memory foam, ensuring a healthier and more environmentally friendly option. The handcrafted organic cotton cover adds a touch of luxury, and it is GOTS certified to guarantee its organic origin.

DOES NOT FALL FLAT: A high-quality natural latex pillow can last for several years without losing its supportive. latex pillows is their resistance to sagging and flattening. Over time, some pillows tend to lose their shape and become less supportive. However, natural latex pillows are designed to resist these issues.

STAYS COOL ALL NIGHT: Pinhole design which enables enhanced air circulation for maximum breathability and temperature regulation. Topped with our organic cotton cover, to ensure you stay cool all night.
ECO-FRIENDLY: Sleep guilt-free with our eco-friendly latex pillow, made from renewable and sustainable rubber tree sap. Choose a greener option for a healthier planet!

REMOVABLE COVER: Enjoy the luxury of our GOTS Certified organic cotton cover, crafted with 100% organic materials. Its removable design ensures effortless washing, while strict environmental and social standards are met for a guilt-free sleep experience.
